name: Hytek | Lantz
description:
Its like getting a Lime Sherbet Float back in grade school. The Lantz gives off a tart lime flavor but also nice and creamy. Its a great mix and balance of flavors!! 

Cross: Ridgeline Runtz x Green Lantern
